dogecoin.text: America is actively PUNISHING those who save & spend wisely. That's what we have come to; rewarding the whining worst of us with handouts by penalizing the best of us. Dogecoin people, have fun learning about capital gains tax! Short term CG might be wiser than Biden CG increase.

@BitchyLiberty I think recent dogecoin investers have an interesting dilemma about whether to sell and face short term capital gains tax. 
Wait is there a minimum to CG tax?

@BitchyLiberty Coins that have a limited supply are supposed to act like gold & should go up when times are economically tough and during inflation. 
The "unlimited" coins are also rising w/ that tide which I find interesting. There's literally zillions of dogecoin. Well maybe not zillions. 🙂

@BitchyLiberty Crypto is fascinating. I worry sometimes about the speculation undermining it's potential. When all the altcoins flooded the market it really alarmed me. Litecoin miners got stuck w/ dogecoin. They've been really successful at periodically pumping & dumping fueled by influencers.
